jobs.description:
Hospitality Agent Front Office

Stellenbeschreibung

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. At The Cloud One Hotels, our goal is to foster an environment where both guests and team members feel comfortable and genuinely welcomed! Your responsibilities include:

- Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Whether you're a professional in the hospitality industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe

What to Expect

Our Country Service Leads are the leaders of our field Service operations. You will be responsible for delivering an exceptional service experience to our customers, developing your team members and organization, managing day-to-day operations, and ensuring Tesla Service meets the needs of our customers as well as the expectations of our employees.As Country Service Lead you will be responsible for all our service locations and lead your Management team and organization to consistently deliver excellent results. To succeed at Tesla, you must be energetic, highly organized, and smart working as well as having a passion for true leadership and the Tesla brand.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and drive strategic decisions for the service organization to ensure growth and to meet current and future business demands
- Proactively guide and coach a team of managers, being present in the field and ensuring managers are empowered to make the right local decisions to drive the business forward
- Regularly review country KPIs, identifying trends and reviewing in more detail with managers if required to quickly address any negative trends or issues
- Constantly assess potential service improvements
- Effectively communicate and motivate teams, as well as adapting to the changing needs of the company
- Collaborate closely with other EMEA Country Leaders, as well as with other business areas ensuring a strong network of peers 
- Manage financials from a service perspective for the country, maintaining an overview of cost savings, employee expenses, operational costs, profit and loss and revenue

What You’ll Bring

- A proven background of managing an organization or region to meet operational and strategic targets
- An open and approachable leadership style, with experience of leading, motivating and coaching managers
- Ability to find, organize and manipulate data for decision making and action taking purposes 
- Excellent organization skills, with experience of high-level reporting
- Ability to move between a high-level, holistic business approach and communicating with employees on a grass-roots level

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems
jobs.description:
1 Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems Your mission
Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems 

 * Taking over and owning the on-site Windows service that bridges our medical measurement devices to the platform. It drives around 10 device families via Bluetooth, serial, TCP and file exchange. 
 * Operation, maintenance and further development of the device drivers, the local REST API, the system-tray status UI, firmware updates and the Windows installer. 
 * Building and shipping releases: PyInstaller executable, NSIS installer, Windows Defender/firewall handling, auto-update mechanism and the PT10 ESP32 firmware flasher. 
 * Rolling out releases to the lab sites and troubleshooting problems that occur on-site - including occasional travel to our locations. 
 * Securing and documenting the systems so they can be maintained by more than one person in the long run. 

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Owning the lab operator web app, an Angular / Ionic / Electron application that runs on the lab PC and guides the operator through login, packages, stations, appointments and the checkup flow. 
 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack. 
 * Integrating with the wider Wellabe platform: the Laravel/PHP admin platform for device master data, the Flask backend that handles body-age calculations and reporting, and the Ionic/Capacitor mobile app for user-facing results. 
 * Improving observability: centralised logging, clearer error signals and faster remote diagnosis so that "it didn't work in Munich on Tuesday" becomes solvable from your desk. 
 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile
Must-haves

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends. 
 * Experience with hardware integration - serial interfaces, Bluetooth, TCP; you can read a device protocol and understand what is happening on the wire. 
 * Frontend skills - solid Angular/TypeScript experience and a practical understanding of Ionic/Capacitor or Electron build chains. 
 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite). 
 * Remote debugging from incomplete information - you can reconstruct what happened from logs, screenshots and second-hand descriptions, without being able to reproduce the issue locally. 
 * Willingness to travel to our offices in Munich and Vienna, and enjoyment of working with real devices. 
 * Fluent German - you need to communicate with local teams and support staff at our lab sites in German-speaking countries. 
 * Good English - collaboration in an international team.

Nice-to-haves

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.

1 In-House Programmatic Specialist (all genders)
1210 Wien, Job-ID: pze3wyxz 

Your responsibilities

 * End-to-End Campaign Trading & Optimization
You manage the daily setup, pacing, bidding strategies, and optimization of all programmatic display, video, audio, and connected TV (CTV) campaigns. You leverage platform-native bidding algorithms, frequency capping, and custom rules/scripts to consistently hit performance KPIs.
 * Marketplace Management & Publisher Relations
You negotiate directly with supply-side platforms (SSPs) and premium publishers to secure Private Marketplace (PMP) deals and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals that drive efficiency and scale for our campaigns.
 * Creative Management & Ad Operations
You traffic and manage creatives via CM360 (Google stack) or Trade Desk's native creative library, ensuring proper ad serving, rotation, and format compliance across display, video (VAST/VPAID), audio, and CTV formats.
 * Measurement, Attribution & Performance Dashboards
You build transparent, automated performance dashboards to track media costs, tech fees, and platform margins. You implement and maintain conversion measurement using Floodlight activities, CM360 attribution models, and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel & conversion events.
 * Stakeholder Communication & Community Leadership
You translate complex programmatic data into clear business insights for internal teams (Marketing, Creative, Leadership). You actively contribute to our internal Programmatic Community and share expertise across the organization.

Your qualifications

 * Deep Programmatic Trading Experience
You bring 3+ years of hands-on programmatic trading experience, with at least 2 years of intensive, daily work inside a DSP platform. Proficiency in one platform is required; working knowledge of multiple platforms is a strong advantage. Prior experience at a digital media agency or as a certified Google Marketing Platform (GMP) partner and/or Trade Desk certified partner is highly preferred.
 * Technical Expertise & Platform Mastery
You demonstrate complete fluency in Floodlight tags, CM360 container structures, URL parameters (Google stack) and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel, conversion event configuration, and tracking parameters. You understand the technical architecture behind modern programmatic advertising.
 * Advanced Analytics & Problem-Solving
You possess advanced skills in data analytics with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into actionable campaign strategies. You troubleshoot creative rejections, pixel drop-offs, and discrepancies across ad servers with ease and precision.
 * Communication & Team Collaboration
You communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders. You work independently and thrive as part of an English-speaking team, bringing both technical depth and interpersonal excellence. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field is a plus.

Your perspective

Depending on the specific qualifications and professional experience, a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 4.000,- is envisaged (this in any case exceeds the minimum salary under the collective agreement). The final salary agreement will be reached in a personal meeting.

At our client you enjoy and value the freedom of a flexible mix of working from home and in the office. You will also benefit from a flat hierarchy and a transparent company structure. The position is available at the earliest possible entry date. This may best be discussed in a job interview.

How do I apply?

We are looking forward to receiving your online application!

jobs.description:
1 Senior Research Engineer - Cross-Platform Microfabrication Processes (all genders) As part of the European Chips Act, Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) is driving innovation in quantum and semiconductor technologies through its Pilot Lines. 

Join our interdisciplinary teams at the interface of technology and fabrication and enjoy Villach's exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Austrian Alps. Be part of something bigger. Be part of Silicon Austria Labs.

The role is part of the new Pilot Line Operations (PLO) Team within the Microsystem Division. PLO is a multidisciplinary engineering team bridging research and pilot-line operations, combining microfabrication expertise, process integration, documentation and coordination between Research Units and the SAL cleanroom infrastructure.

Your future tasks include:
 * Hands-on execution of microfabrication processes across lithography, deposition, etching, cleaning, metrology and other relevant process modules.
 * Develop, integrate, troubleshoot and optimize complex microfabrication process flows, including cross-tool and cross-module interactions.
 * Execute and lead fabrication runs, analyze results and identify process integration issues, deviations and root causes: pilot-line runs, MPWs, technology demonstrators and external fabrication activities.
 * Assessing Technology and pilot-line maturity.
 * Work directly with scientists to translate new research concepts into fabricable process flows and experimental process runs.
 * Work closely with cleanroom tool owners and engineers to ensure compatibility with tool capabilities, cleanroom constraints and operational requirements.
 * Define and maintain process documentation, flow diagrams, process specifications, run sheets, recipes, track of changes and lessons learned.
 * Help establish standardized ways of working for process development, integration, documentation, qualification and scale-up.
 * Platform Specialization: Focusing primarily on one of the key Microsystems technology platforms (Quantum Technologies, Photonics, PiezoMEMS, Magnetic Microsystems) but operating across multiple projects.

Your profile:
 * MSc/PhD in microelectronics, microsystems, semiconductors, physics or a related field.
 * 5+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor, MEMS, photonics or microfabrication technology, preferably in a cleanroom industrial environment.
 * Demonstrated expertise in fabrication process development and integration, with the ability to execute and troubleshoot processes. 
 * Broad understanding of multiple microfabrication modules and their interactions, rather than expertise limited to a single process step. 
 * Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to move between hands-on cleanroom work, process engineering, documentation and coordination. 
 * Strong organizational and documentation skills for technical reporting and professional documentation. 
 * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively while supporting multiple stakeholders.
 * Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills. 
 * Excellent oral and written communication skills in English (German is a plus)

Important Facts about SAL:
 * Diverse research activities with many technical challenges.
 * State-of-the-art laboratory facilities and equipment.
 * Location in the heart of Europe in Austria - relocation support for non-European nationalities.
 * Internal and external training opportunities for career development.
 * Family & children friendly - actively shaping the compatibility of family and career.
 * "Vital4SAL" to promote a healthy workplace (e.g. SAL coaching pool, trainings on mental health, physical activities, healthy snacks, 24/7 accident insurance)
